'''Bezar One''' was the protege of [[Teha Zero]], the founder of the [[Cybernetics/Legends|cyberneticist]] cult known as the [[New Men]]. When Zero [[Death/Legends|died]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Bezar One took over the New Men and turned the peaceful group into a pro-[[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] terrorist organization and orchestrated a series of violent raids to steal equipment across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]]. The New Men murdered anyone who interfered, and One planned for an "electric ascension" that would have empowered cyborgs and killed thousands of organics. The plan was ultimately foiled and One was imprisoned with his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where they continued to recruit members.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bezar One was mentioned in the Codex entry for the New Men in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
